input: Source a local frame shop for large canvas prints

gold.taskTitle: Source a local frame shop for large canvas prints
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate a local frame shop capable of handling large canvas print framing.

questions.title: What are the exact dimensions of your canvas prints?
questions.description: Understand the specific size requirements to find a shop equipped for large-format framing.

questions.title: How many canvas prints need to be framed?
questions.description: Determine the quantity to assess whether bulk pricing or capacity matters.

questions.title: What is your budget per frame or total?
questions.description: Establish financial constraints to filter suitable shops by price range.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the shop be located in?
questions.description: Pin down the geographic area to narrow the local search effectively.

questions.title: Do you have a specific frame style or material in mind?
questions.description: Identify aesthetic or material preferences such as wood, metal, floating frames, etc.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having these framed?
questions.description: Understand time constraints to prioritize shops that can meet the turnaround needed.

questions.title: Are these prints for personal use or a professional setting?
questions.description: Clarify the end-use context to gauge quality expectations and presentation standards.
